dlentry.dd: One audience's version of the docs: unfiltered, or filtered by one DITAVAL file.
The run's verdict. Pass when no topic failed a check and no link is broken.
An approved XSLT template that rewrites one element before conversion.
A numbered token that carries a conref, key, condition or ID through conversion.
A source element with no Markdown form and no rule. It goes to a writer.
A MyST variable that holds a value defined once, as a DITA key does.
